UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Authenticated user account root document anchoring ownership for synced challenge data.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account document was last updated.

ChallengeProgress.title: ChallengeProgress
ChallengeProgress.description: Cross-device synced 30-Day Challenge progress, logbook entries, reps, XP ledger, badges, and settings.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the progress owner.

profile.description: User profile metadata including displayName (maxLength 100) and createdAt.

settings.description: User preferences for theme, sound, haptics, and motion.

days.description: Map of DayNumber (1-30) to DayProgress records.

logEntries.description: Map of DayNumber (1-30) to LogEntry reflection records.

repEvents.description: Bounded list (max 5000) of RepEvent interaction records.

xpEvents.description: Bounded list (max 5000) of append-only XpEvent records.

openedChests.description: List of opened chapter chest IDs (max 4).

unlockedBadges.description: Map of badge ID to ISO unlock timestamp.

lastDeviceId.description: Identifier of the browser session that wrote this revision.

clientUpdatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the local state mutation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when cloud sync was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest cloud sync.

/users/{userId}.description: Private root account document owned exclusively by {userId}.

/users/{userId}/sync/{syncId}.description: Private challenge progress sync document (syncId = 'challenge_v1') owned by {userId}.
